## Summary
The money layer under every run (spec §14.4; REQ-SPEC-24). Adds **`@rhema/ledger`** — the sole real implementation of the orchestrator's `HoldLedger` port and the owner of every `credit_ledger` / `credit_balances` mutation path: ledger ops with idempotency, the cap-clamped debit math, refund/resume-re-debit semantics, the nightly balances-assertion, the circuit breaker, the 30-day parked-run sweep, and the `/pricing/rates` publication. Implements ticket `docs/tickets/12_P0.11__credit-ledger.md`.

Pure and dependency-injected; all six ACs are deterministic over PGlite, and the orchestrator drives the real ledger end-to-end. Live call-site wiring (resume re-debit, cap-multiplier consumption, the parked cron) is deferred with the live worker (D-P0.11-1); Stripe (PRB.8) and full trial pricing (P1.16) stay out of scope per the ticket.

## What changed
- **`packages/ledger`** (new `@rhema/ledger`): `buckets` (consumption order + `drawFromBuckets`), `balance-effect` (the one signed-delta source), `entries` (idempotent `applyLedgerEntry` + `grant`), `expiry`, `sql-ledger` (`SqlHoldLedger`: hold/debit/release/refund), `resume` (`refundPhases`, `reDebitRefundedPhases`), `assertion`, `circuit-breaker`, `parked`, `rates`, and a `testing/` harness.
- **`packages/db/migrations/0011_credit_ledger.sql`**: the `Σ debits − Σ refunds ≤ cap` assertion trigger, two supporting indexes, least-privilege grants for `credit_balances` / `billing_accounts` / `trial_entitlements`.
- **`packages/contracts/src/domain/rates.ts`**: the versioned rate tables + list-cost math + `/pricing/rates` builder, **lifted** here as the single source (REQ-BILL-2); `apps/egress-proxy/src/rates.ts` now re-exports them (no behavior change).
- **`apps/api`**: public `GET /pricing/rates` (REQ-BILL-19).
- **`docs/tickets/DEFERRALS.md`**: D-P0.11-1/2/3 appended; D-P0.08-2's rate-table unblocker marked satisfied.

## Design decisions
- **The port stays in the orchestrator; the adapter lives in `@rhema/ledger`** (which depends on `@rhema/orchestrator` for the port types). Zero orchestrator churn — the 600+ existing tests keep using the `TestHoldLedger` stub unchanged; apps inject `new SqlHoldLedger({ids,clock})` at deploy.
- **Multi-bucket, ledger-derived accounting.** A hold reserves the cap across buckets in consumption order (total-balance check, matching REQ-SPEC-24.2's "one balance"); per-run per-bucket held is derived from the run's own ledger rows (Σhold − Σdebit − Σrelease), so debit/release/refund need no extra state.
- **Cap is enforced on NET debits** (Σdebit − Σrefund), so a refunded partial can be re-debited on resume (REQ-SPEC-24.6) without the assertion trigger firing.
- **`adjustment(absorbed)` has zero balance effect** — the cap overrun is booked to the variance reserve, never charged; entitlement runs skip the ledger entirely (not booked as absorbed, so they don't pollute the breaker).

## Verification
- `pnpm turbo build lint typecheck` → green (87 tasks).
- `pnpm test` → **774 passed / 111 files** (baseline 733); `@rhema/ledger` contributes 40 deterministic tests.
- An **independent fresh-context review** found three real correctness issues (a refund/resume money-loss, a re-debit gap, an entitlement double-spend) plus three robustness gaps (lock ordering, missing run locks, non-deterministic retry bucket); **all six are fixed and regression-tested** (see the multi-episode refund→resume→refund test).

## Acceptance criteria → evidence
| AC (ticket) | Evidence |
|---|---|
| REQ-BILL-3: 3× usage → debits = cap + `adjustment(absorbed)`, 402 + delivered dossier (delivery never rolls back) | `sql-ledger.test.ts` "fault-injected 3×" (debits=840, absorbed=1680) + the trigger-fires test; the 402 is the proxy's (P0.07) and the non-rollback is the delivery tx's (P0.09) — debit stays a separate transaction |
| Two concurrent holds, one balance fits → exactly one succeeds (row lock) | `sql-ledger.test.ts` "AC2 (row lock)" — `select … for update` on the billing account; the loser gets `InsufficientBalanceError` |
| Nightly assertion detects a planted balances/ledger divergence | `assertion.test.ts` — `assertBalances` folds `balanceEffect` over the ledger and flags a planted +250 / −40 drift |
| Consumption-order property test across all five buckets incl. expiries | `buckets.test.ts` (1000-case property) + `expiry.test.ts` (expired bucket skipped) |
| Stop-mid-run: completed debited, rest released; resume-after-refund re-debits refunded first | `resume.test.ts` — stop (debit 312, release rest) + refund p1 → re-debit p1 first + the multi-episode cycle |
| Circuit breaker: absorbed crossing X% flips new-run cap multiplier to 2× | `circuit-breaker.test.ts` — 33% > 5% → `capMultiplier 2` + `page`; 24 h window respected |
